description: Add bill forecasting component using historical data to predict future electricity costs
steps: Create src/components/BillForecast.tsx with: input for up to 6 previous monthly bills in ₹, line chart showing historical bars + forecast line, forecast calculation: 3-month rolling average of last 3 entries, clear disclaimer label: 'Estimate only - actual bills may vary'
Integrate with localStorage: key 'wattwise_history' to persist bill history
Use Recharts for visualization (line chart + bar chart combination)
Add BillForecast to CalculatorPage (App.tsx) or as a separate tab
Ensure all currency values use formatINR
Add validation for bill input (positive numbers, reasonable ranges)
acceptance_criteria: Users can enter historical bill amounts in ₹
Forecast shows as line extending beyond historical data
Chart visualization is clear and informative
verification: Verify forecast calculation matches manual 3-month average
Test chart renders correctly with both bars and line
Refresh page and confirm data persistence
Validate input rejects negative or invalid values
